prompts.hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production standardized isometric pixel character sprite atlas for TOUCHLINE. Image1 is the canonical art/model-sheet reference: match its proportions, head size, camera elevation, pixel density, dark contour thickness and three-tone shading exactly across ALL sixteen poses. Create a NEW atlas with exactly 16 isolated full-body sprites in a strict regular 4x4 grid, true transparent PNG. Same person and identical clothes in every cell, same scale and anatomy, same head size (one-quarter standing body height), no drift. Every sprite complete from hair to boot soles, no detached shadows or objects. Generous equal gutters, feet on matching cell baseline, body centered. Low-resolution square pixel clusters, readable at 40px standing height. NO labels, text, brand, numbers, scene, gradients or smooth illustration.
ROWS: row1 screen SE/down-right, front 3/4 visible; row2 SW/down-left front 3/4; row3 NE/up-right, back 3/4 visible; row4 NW/up-left back 3/4 visible.
COLUMNS: 1 neutral standing with feet grounded; 2 walking, left foot forward and right arm forward; 3 walking OPPOSITE stride, right foot forward and left arm forward (visibly different legs, identical head and torso volume); 4 ACTION specified below. Directions of face, feet, arms and action must match each row. Do not rotate to a different direction within a row. Camera remains high-angle isometric as reference.
Identity: young adult Brazilian male, medium brown skin, short dark brown hair, mustard casual polo shirt with cream collar, navy jeans, dark sneakers. Action column4: standing conversational gesture with one hand raised. SAME male body/head volume as reference, clothes only change.
